title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2 Episode 14
key_events: Mei Mei kills Smallpox Deity using Ui Ui help. Kenjaku appears and reveals his true form, revealing his plan to use the Shibuya Incident to evolve cursed energy and create a world dominated by curses. Dagon confronts Nanami, Maki, and Naobito in Shibuya Station. Dagon activates his Domain Expansion, but Megumi counters with his own Domain Expansion, creating a weak point. Nanami and Naobito survive, but Toji emerges from the domain's escape route.
content:
Mei Mei defeats the Smallpox Deity cursed spirit by using Ui Ui and her crows as a distraction; after the battle, the siblings are confronted by Pseudo-Geto (Kenjaku).
In Shibuya Station, Nanami, Maki, and Naobito face the cursed spirit Dagon, who has transformed from a cursed womb into his fully evolved form.
Dagon activates his Domain Expansion; within the domain, Nanami and Naobito are consumed by a horde of his shikigami.
From outside, Megumi activates his own Domain Expansion, which disrupts Dagon's and creates a weak point.
Nanami and Naobito survive, but before the three can escape, Toji emerges through the domain's escape route.
